issues.description: Person entity ID type is inconsistent: template declares field `private Long id;` but solution declares `private Integer id;` while both repositories use `JpaRepository<Person, Long>` and service/resource methods expect `Long` IDs. This mismatch would either not compile (Integer cannot be returned as Long) or misleads students about the correct ID type to use in their implementations and REST calls.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent with the template and repository by changing the solution's `Person.id` field type from `Integer` to `Long` (and keep `getId()`/`setId(Long)` accordingly). Alternatively, if `Integer` is intended, then update both template and solution consistently and change `PersonRepository` and all `Long personId` usages to `Integer`.
